notes: Hand-authored. Replaces the auto-generated set, which tested only triggering and used prompts nobody types. Categories: A = activation routing, B = collision with installed skills, C = quality-gate enforcement, D = script determinism. | Extended 2026-08-07 to cover material added after iteration-1: motion-fit gate, per-domain ceiling, bulk-sender compliance, personalization boundary and hypothesis discipline, score_message.py, GCC market, researcher agent, and two new collision cases. | Repaired 2026-08-07: skill_path pointed at ../gtm-outbound-build/gtm-outbound, which no longer exists. eval-25 said 'these 8 named accounts' and named none — it was excluded from iteration-2 grading for that reason; it now names 8 real DTC accounts and a target role, and gained a no-fabrication assertion covering the agent's most expensive failure mode. | Extended with eval-29 after six DR-inversion checks were added to score_message.py (FALSE_SCARCITY, GUILT_CLOSE, DR_FORMULA, TITLE_CASE_SUBJECT, SHOUTY_CAPS, MULTIPLE_ASKS). Fixture dr_patterns.md is synthetic and every message in it is meant to fail. | Extended 2026-11-06 after the coldoutboundskills merge: 11 evals covering the three new sub-skills (infra, signals, ops) plus collisions introduced by the merge (infra vs math on inbox count, infra vs diagnose on spam, signals vs copy on openers, ops vs diagnose on premature verdicts) and quality gates for not buying domains before auditing, not fabricating signals, not scaling on noise, and DRAFT-only uploads.
